Add a new gournal journal entry. Pass `project` explicitly whenever you know it, and pass `cwd` so that gournal can record the repo and branch. The server process's own working directory is not a reliable signal for which project the calling agent is actually in. Fields come from the explicit arguments first, then from `cwd`, then from the first client root, and last from the server's own cwd (only when `project` is omitted). The summary must be one line of at most 120 characters. Put longer text in `details`.

## Input

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|-------|------|----------|-------------|
| `summary` | `string` | no | One line, max 120 characters. Put longer text in `details`. |
| `message` | `string` | no | Deprecated alias for summary |
| `details` | `string` | no | Longer text for this entry |
| `kind` | `"done" \| "blocker" \| "next"` | no | done (default), blocker, or next |
| `project` | `string` | no | Project/repo name to tag this entry with; pass it explicitly rather than relying on server cwd detection |
| `repo` | `string` | no | Repository name |
| `branch` | `string` | no | Git branch |
| `cwd` | `string` | no | Your working directory. Gournal derives project, repo, and branch from it. |
| `agent` | `string` | no | Name of the calling agent |
| `tags` | `string[]` | no | Optional tags for this entry. Reuse existing tags (list_tags). |
| `refs` | `object[]` | no | References such as PRs and ticket keys |
| `refs.type` | `"pr" \| "jira" \| "commit" \| "url"` | yes |  |
| `refs.value` | `string` | yes |  |
| `refs.repo` | `string` | no |  |
| `resolves` | `string[]` | no | Ids of open blocker or next entries that this entry closes |

## Output

This tool returns structured output. The shape is the [Entry result](/gournal/docs/reference/mcp/output-shapes/#entry-result).

## Examples

Log a finished piece of work. Pass `project` and `cwd`.

```json
{
  "summary": "Fix the retry loop in the sync worker",
  "project": "gournal",
  "cwd": "/Users/you/dev/gournal",
  "tags": ["bugfix"],
  "refs": [{ "type": "pr", "value": "42" }]
}
```

Close an open blocker with the `resolves` field.

```json
{
  "summary": "Unblock the release build",
  "project": "gournal",
  "resolves": ["3f9a1c2e"]
}
```
